observations.rationale: The actor 'the Secretary' is explicitly stated in the statutory text of 29 U.S.C. 1025(a)(2)(D)(ii), and this actor and its associated requirement are already accurately and completely represented in C0021.
The referenced provision section 1021(i)(8)(B) of title 29 is not provided within the focus or supplied context, so the reference target remains external and unresolved.
